title: hieracium rusanum
intro: Hieracium rusanum, commonly known as mountain hawkweed, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and protect against cell damage. Therapeutically, Hieracium rusanum is used for its hepatoprotective and diuretic actions, supporting liver function and promoting the removal of toxins from the body. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium rusanum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
